name: Chocolate Mint Squares
ingredients: 1/2 cup - sliced almonds or chopped walnuts
instructions: Melt unsweetened chocolate with 1/2 butter over low heat
Beat eggs, then beat in sugar gradually
Combine flour and baking powder, then stir into egg/sugar mixture
Stir in chocolate mixture and almonds/walnuts
Pour batter into a greased 9 inch square cake pan
Bake for 25 minutes, until toothpick comes out clean
Meanwhile, blend 1/4 cup butter with icing sugar, cream, flavouring until smooth
Spread over cooled cake and chill until firm
Melt semi-sweet chocolate with butter on very low heat or in a double-boiler
